title: Steam Unable to Connect to Server
shortDescription: Steam client cannot connect to Steam servers.
fullDescription:
Error 101 appears when the Steam client cannot reach any Steam server. Usually caused by local networking issues, firewall blocks, Steam outage, or corrupted client configuration.

The error also shows up after failed log-ins or when a VPN changes routing mid-session. Start with checking Steam's own status page to rule out a platform outage before troubleshooting your machine.
symptoms: 'Unable to connect to server. Server may be offline or you may not be connected to the Internet. Error code: -101'
Web browser works but Steam won't connect

fixSteps.title: Check Steam status
fixSteps.instruction: Visit steamstat.us to verify server health.

fixSteps.title: Restart Steam
fixSteps.instruction: Exit completely from the tray and relaunch.

fixSteps.title: Allow Steam through firewall
fixSteps.instruction: Windows Defender Firewall > Allow an app > add steam.exe.

fixSteps.title: Clear download cache
fixSteps.instruction: Steam > Settings > Downloads > Clear Download Cache.

faq.a: No. Error 101 is a connectivity error, not an account issue.

title: Steam Cloud Sync Error
shortDescription: Steam was unable to sync your files with Steam Cloud.
fullDescription:
Error 53 occurs when the Steam client cannot reach Steam Cloud to sync save files. This can be caused by Cloud outages, a previous conflict that Steam never resolved, or network throttling.

If you continue past the warning you risk losing cloud progress. Resolve before launching the game whenever possible.
symptoms: 'Unable to sync — could not sync your files with Steam Cloud' error 53
Prompt to play offline or retry

fixSteps.title: Verify game files
fixSteps.instruction: Library > right-click game > Properties > Installed Files > Verify.

title: Steam Unable to Connect to Web Page
shortDescription: Steam web browser cannot connect to Store or Community pages.
fullDescription: Error 118 means Steam's built-in browser timed out reaching store.steampowered.com or steamcommunity.com. Normally rooted in DNS, IPv6 stack issues, or security software blocking the Steam browser.
symptoms: 'Unable to connect to server... Error Code: -118' when opening Store

fixSteps.title: Disable AV web shield
fixSteps.instruction: Test with AV network filter off.

title: Steam Failed to Load Webpage
shortDescription: Steam's browser failed to load the requested page (unknown error).
fullDescription: Error 130 is Steam's generic browser timeout. Commonly caused by a broken HTML cache in the Steam client, VPN/proxy interference, or regional routing issues.
symptoms: 'Failed to load web page (unknown error)' error 130 on Store/Community

title: Steam Unable to Load Webpages
shortDescription: Steam cannot load Store pages due to blocked endpoints.
fullDescription: Error 138 generally indicates something is intercepting or blocking Steam's HTTP requests — often a host-file entry, IPv6 transition issue, or corporate proxy.

title: Steam Friends Network No Connection
shortDescription: Steam Friends panel shows 'No Connection'.
fullDescription: Only the friends/chat sub-system is offline. Usually a partial Steam outage or port 27017 being blocked by a network filter.

fixSteps.title: Disable beta
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Interface > Opt out of beta.

title: Epic Games Launcher Cannot Connect
shortDescription: Epic Games Launcher can't connect to Epic services.
fullDescription: AS-3 means the launcher failed to reach Epic's authentication/services endpoints. Common causes are VPN routing, blocked TLS, or a temporary Epic outage.
symptoms: 'There was an error while logging in. Please try again.' AS-3

title: Epic Games Launcher Download Error
shortDescription: The Epic Games Launcher could not download the game.
fullDescription: DP-1 indicates a download interruption. Root causes include disk write failures, antivirus quarantine of partially-downloaded files, or insufficient permissions on the install directory.
symptoms: Download error DP-1 during game install or update

fixSteps.title: Change install path
fixSteps.instruction: Pick a folder on a drive you own.

fixSteps.title: Check disk space
fixSteps.instruction: Need headroom equal to game size.

title: Epic Launcher Install Failed
shortDescription: Installation failed — required files cannot be written.
fullDescription: LS-0013 is thrown when the launcher cannot write to the install directory. Often OneDrive-redirected Documents, read-only folders, or SmartScreen interference.

title: Epic Launcher Update Failed 1603
shortDescription: Epic Games Launcher self-update failed (MSI 1603).
fullDescription: SU-PQR1603 is a Windows Installer 1603 — a fatal install error inside MSI. Usually resolved by reinstalling the launcher manually.
symptoms: 'Installation of xxx has failed' after launching Epic

title: Battle.net Disconnected From Service
shortDescription: Battle.net lost connection to Blizzard's back-end.
fullDescription: This error disconnects you from the Battle.net service. Typically a server outage, regional routing problem, or a broken local Battle.net Agent.
symptoms: 'You have been disconnected from the Battle.net service' during play

title: Battle.net Game Files Damaged
shortDescription: Battle.net detected corrupted game files during download.
fullDescription: The desktop app detected hash mismatches during install or update. Most often caused by disk errors or AV interference during download.

fixSteps.title: Run Scan and Repair
fixSteps.instruction: Battle.net > game > gear icon > Scan and Repair.

title: Battle.net Agent Update Error
shortDescription: The Battle.net Agent could not update itself.
fullDescription: Agent.exe failed to update due to permission issues or AV blocking. Often fixed by resetting Battle.net Agent data.
symptoms: Battle.net stuck on 'Updating Battle.net Update Agent'

title: League of Legends Error 004 (Login)
shortDescription: League of Legends client could not log you in.
fullDescription: Error 004 appears during login when the client cannot authenticate. Generally caused by Riot authentication outages or regional routing problems.

title: League of Legends Error 003 (Client)
shortDescription: Riot client failed to start a game session.
fullDescription: Error 003 indicates client-to-server handshake failed during matchmaking or queue. Often a local network or anti-cheat issue (Vanguard/Packman).

title: Riot Client Error 400 (Gateway Error)
shortDescription: Riot client received a bad request response from a gateway.
fullDescription: A transient communication error between client and Riot services. Often resolved by restarting. If persistent, may indicate account data corruption requiring Riot Support.
symptoms: Error 400 pop-up in lobby or after game

title: League of Legends Error 900 (Map Load)
shortDescription: League of Legends failed to load the game map.
fullDescription: Error 900 appears at the loading screen when the client cannot load required assets. Commonly caused by corrupt game files or insufficient privileges.

title: GOG Galaxy Connection Lost
shortDescription: GOG Galaxy lost connection to GOG services.
fullDescription: Galaxy cannot reach GOG CDN. Often an outage, or the Galaxy database cache is corrupt.

title: GOG Galaxy Install Access Denied
shortDescription: Galaxy cannot write to the install directory.
fullDescription: Access denied (0x80070005) during game install. Usually OneDrive-backed or otherwise protected directory.
symptoms: Install stops with access denied error

fixSteps.title: Change install path
fixSteps.instruction: Pick a plain folder on a local drive.

title: Ubisoft Connect Service Unavailable
shortDescription: Ubisoft Connect cannot reach the online services.
fullDescription: A family of 2-XXX-XXXXXXX errors indicates Ubisoft's service or your connection can't reach it. Often resolvable via hosts file / IPv6 toggle.

title: Ubisoft Connect Download Error
shortDescription: Ubisoft Connect failed to download game files.
fullDescription: 2-0x00000067 is a download/update failure. Fixed by running Connect as admin, verifying files, or changing download region.

title: EA App Invalid License
shortDescription: EA App reports invalid license for this title.
fullDescription: Frequently after migrating from Origin, using a VPN, or when EA's license service is down. Re-authenticating or rebuilding the license cache usually resolves.
symptoms: 'License invalid' when launching an EA game

fixSteps.title: Reset EA App
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Repair or Reset in Apps list.

title: EA App Failed to Launch Game
shortDescription: EA App game failed to launch with 0xc000007b.
fullDescription: The game could not initialize due to 32/64-bit DLL mismatch or missing redistributables. Typical of older EA titles after Windows feature updates.

title: Xbox PC App Connection Error
shortDescription: Xbox PC app cannot sign in to Xbox Live.
fullDescription: PC-specific Xbox Live connectivity error. Frequently caused by Teredo issues or corrupt Xbox Identity Provider.

fixSteps.title: Enable Teredo
fixSteps.instruction: netsh interface teredo set state type=default.

title: Xbox PC Game Install Error
shortDescription: Xbox PC app fails to install a game.
fullDescription: Installation error on Xbox app — typically Gaming Services corruption or a protected install location.
symptoms: Xbox app install stuck at 0% or errors out

fixSteps.title: Reinstall Gaming Services
fixSteps.instruction: PowerShell: Get-AppxPackage *GamingServices* | Remove-AppxPackage; then from Store.

title: PS Remote Play Connection Speed Not Fast Enough
shortDescription: PS Remote Play reports insufficient network speed.
fullDescription: Remote Play dropped the connection because measured throughput/latency fell below threshold. Frequently a Wi-Fi issue or heavy background traffic.
symptoms: 'Your connection speed isn't fast enough' on PC

fixSteps.title: Use wired Ethernet on both ends
Move closer to router / 5 GHz band

title: PS Remote Play Cannot Find Console
shortDescription: Remote Play cannot find the registered PlayStation console.
fullDescription: The PS console is not reachable via LAN/Internet — it may be off, in rest mode without Remote Play enabled, or NAT is blocking discovery.

fixSteps.title: Enable Rest Mode features
fixSteps.instruction: On PS: Settings > System > Power Saving > Features in Rest Mode — enable internet + turn on from network.

fixSteps.title: Register manually
fixSteps.instruction: Use activation code from PS Remote Play settings.

title: Steam Library No Connection Tag
shortDescription: A game in Steam library shows 'No Connection'.
fullDescription: Individual library entries flag as 'No Connection' when Steam can't verify ownership due to an auth timeout. Often fixed by signing out and back in.

title: EA App Installation Error 0x80000003
shortDescription: EA App installer failed during setup.
fullDescription: Installer rejects due to .NET or WebView2 component being missing/damaged — often on fresh Windows installs.

title: GOG Galaxy Network Request Failed
shortDescription: Galaxy request to GOG backend failed.
fullDescription: Repeated failures imply DNS or firewall issues. Try switching DNS or running Galaxy with elevated privileges.
